name: NetFlowBench-Mini
description: Companion artifact for the IEEE MCAIT 2026 paper "NetFlowBench-Mini." Contains a seeded generator, the full 2,300-record synthetic benchmark, the frozen 70/30 train/test split, a metrics summary, the six paper figures, and scripts to reproduce every result, including the NSL-KDD external validation. No real traffic, personal data, or attack tooling is included; all records are statistical abstractions. Released under the MIT License.
